description: Defines the SwapChain11 class for managing a Direct3D 11 swap chain, including methods for resizing, resetting, swapping buffers, and accessing render targets and textures.

classes.name: SwapChain11
classes.description: A class representing a D3D11 swap chain with methods for buffer management and rendering.

methods.name: SwapChain11
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the swap chain with renderer, window, and format parameters.

methods.name: ~SwapChain11
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up swap chain resources.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the swap chain with new dimensions and swap interval.

methods.name: swapRect
methods.description: Performs buffer swapping within specified rectangle.

methods.name: getRenderTargetShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the render target.

methods.name: getDepthStencilShaderResource
methods.description: Returns the shader resource view for the depth stencil.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the swap chain.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the swap chain.
